# DeepSeek V4 announced

DeepSeek V4 was announced on 2026-09-30 in a post by the lab, and the weights will follow.

DeepSeek V4 has 1.2 trillion total parameters according to the announcement. The lab says the model is aimed at reasoning and coding and that a smaller distilled variant is planned.

The announcement does not give a release date for the weights. It says only that they will be published "in the coming weeks" and that the API will open to a limited group of customers first.

## Background

V4 follows V3.2, which the lab released earlier this year. The lab has been publishing technical notes more regularly since V3, and says a full technical report for V4 will accompany the weights.

Pricing for the hosted API was not announced.
